speaker: john_heminges
text: The holiday boxes stand where I said they stood on Monday. Eleven pound eight, to the sharers' side. Today is not that paper.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then tell me what today is, before someone spends Monday twice.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Today the gallery is not all down. I will not strike a share out of a box I have not got on the cloth. I have started the reckoning. I have not finished a sum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not finish one for my sake. I did not come to carry a new figure home. Egeon is done. The tale was long, and it is the same tale.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art wanted up the lane when this is a reckoning and not a play. I am not sitting through a second count of Monday.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Eleven pound eight was a good Monday, and it was without a trumpet, and I have already been pleased with it. If today is not ready, say so and let a man go to his supper.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I am saying so. No item of a share today. The gatherers are not in. When they are in, the paper will have a figure, and it will not be a figure I invent at a half-empty cloth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. Edith's eight shillings is still owing till Lady Day, and it is not in this cloth either. I am not mixing the two.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Do not mix them. The eight shillings is a promise. Monday is a sum already said. Today is neither, until the box is whole.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we are done with money. Thou hast a page for me, Will, and the Jackdaw will not keep eggs warm because John is honest.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Go and be honest over eggs. Leave me the half-cloth. I like a reckoning that cannot yet disappoint me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You may have it. I am not staying to be disappointed, and I am not staying to be paid. Dick is walking. I said I would read him the act.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Read him the act. The coffer is not open. I would not have you write a total you have not seen, and you have not seen one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not write a total. Monday remains eleven pound eight. Today remains uncast. That is as much account as I mean to keep in my head up the lane.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then get your cloak. Thou hast talked the money into a corner, and the corner is John's, and I am hungry.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Hungry is allowed. A new share is not, not from a box still on the stair. Go on, the pair of you. I will tell you if the cloth grows a number, which it will not before you are gone.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It will not. When it does, it will be written once, and not whispered up the road as if it were already a man's own.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then good night to the cloth. I played. I am not taking a share that has not been struck. Come, Dick.

speaker: john_heminges
text: If a man asks you in the lane what you earned, say that you do not know. I do not know. I will not have a guess walking about as if it were mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then that is the answer. I played Egeon. I did not open a box.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Egeon, and no box. A very pure Saturday. I shall envy it for as long as this cloth stays empty, which I hope is not the whole night.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Envy it on the road. Thou art between me and the door, Will.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am through it. John, leave today's paper blank until a sum is true.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is blank. I do not write a hope where a sum goes. There is no sum yet.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I am already at the door. Bring the pages, not the book of accounts.
